name: CuffMinigames
short: Connect 4 and Tic-Tac-Toe played for donuts, winner takes the pot.
description: Fork of crab-cogs minigames with the precinct's money rules: every seat pays a fixed entry fee (the bot's included), the winner takes the whole pot, and a pot the player does not win goes into the crack pot. Connect 4 also shows which line won.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild game settings only.
